PhD degree and PhD programmes
Do you want to pursue a career in scientific research? Then join the Twente Graduate School to follow a PhD programme or apply for a PhD position.
Twente Graduate School
The Twente Graduate School of the University of Twente offers an increasing number of integrated master's degree and PhD programmes for outstanding graduate students who aim to pursue a career in scientific research.
PhD position & programmes
Unlike many other countries, the Netherlands pays most PhD researchers, who often work directly for the university in question, as it would employees. Some PhD researchers come to the Netherlands with an international scholarship.
